I am an Assistant Professor in the department of Economics at the University of California, Berkeley. I was a Postdoctoral Fellow at the Stanford Institute for Economic Policy Research (SIEPR) in 2025-2026. I work on questions in political economy, environmental economics, and empirical industrial organization. 

 I received my PhD in [Sustainable Development from Columbia University](https://www.sipa.columbia.edu/sipa-education/phd-sustainable-development) in 2025.
